description: This file defines a React component named RecommendationsPanel, which displays personalized recommendations such as breathing exercises, music, or podcasts. It fetches suggestions using a deterministic engine based on user mood and traffic data, with fallback static content. The component includes event handlers for user interactions and logs actions for analytics.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Event handler for refreshing the recommendations list, currently a placeholder.

methods.name: onStartBreathing
methods.description: Triggers when the breathing recommendation is activated; logs event and shows alert.

methods.name: onPlay
methods.description: Triggers when music recommendation is activated; logs event and shows placeholder alert.

methods.name: onListen
methods.description: Triggers when podcast recommendation is activated; logs event and shows placeholder alert.

methods.name: handleAction
methods.description: Determines the appropriate action based on the suggestion type and invokes the corresponding handler.
